manifest.js: const form=document.querySelector("form"); for(const input of form.querySelectorAll("input"))input.addEventListener("input",()=>{const values=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));rich.setDraft(values,Object.keys(values))}); form.addEventListener("submit",async event=>{event.preventDefault();const values=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));rich.setDraft(values,Object.keys(values));await rich.submit(values,{actionId:"phase3-action"})});rich.onState(s=>{document.querySelector("output").textContent=s.actions.at(-1)?.state||"等待输入";if(s.draft.fields.title&&!document.querySelector("input[name=title]").value){for(const input of form.querySelectorAll("input"))input.value=s.draft.fields[input.name]||""}})
